answer: Escrowed long-horizon payout: each agent posts a refundable deposit that vests only after N epochs of verified work, with a raven each epoch sampling one random attestation to audit. A failed audit forfeits the full unvested deposit and resets the clock. Clones must fund a fresh deposit per identity, so attack cost scales linearly with fake count while an honest agent pays once. A mirror check ties attestations to the deposit's own transaction lineage.
